title: SQL Injection in administrator login
impact: An unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication and gain administrator access.
remediation: Use parameterized queries for authentication and never concatenate user input into SQL.

title: SQL Injection through product search
payload_used: qwert')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: An attacker can retrieve user email addresses and password hashes through the product search response.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and limit search responses to the intended product fields.

title: Reflected XSS in order tracking
impact: A crafted tracking link executes JavaScript in the browser of a user who opens it.
remediation: Validate the tracking identifier and encode it as text before rendering it into the page.

title: Stored XSS in customer feedback
impact: The saved feedback payload executes in browsers when the customer feedback page is viewed.
remediation: Sanitize feedback on the server with a maintained allowlist and render untrusted content as text.
